后半夜的时候，下面突然吵了起来，还有人砰砰的砸门，声音很吵。时笙皱着眉坐起来，千黎依旧缩在窗户那里，见时笙动了，他立即蹭了过来，眼巴巴的瞅着时笙的手指。

马戈壁，又要吃！

时笙认命的给未来丧尸皇喂了奶，烦躁的扒拉了下头发，拿着铁剑往门口走。

千黎跟了两步，但也不知想到什么，又慢慢的退回了窗户边。

时笙站在门口听了一会儿，只有吵闹声，没有尖叫，应该不是有人变丧尸了，她这才拉开门。

门外的人砸门的东西落了空，黑暗中看到一个人影站在面前，那人惊叫了一声，猛的往后退了几步。

她这叫声引来了其他人，有人用异能弄出了火球，往时笙所在的方向扔过去。

那人应该只是想用来照明，所以火球在时笙一米远的地方就停下了，正好让下面的人看清她的身形。

“是个人……吓死我了，还以为是丧尸呢。”

“刚才人家就说了三楼是有人的，你们非要去砸人家的门，这下好了。”

“我们还不是担心……”

“担心什么？赵妍，别以为你那点小心思没人知道。”

人群再次吵闹起来，时笙头疼的揉了揉眉心，没好气的道：“你们想干什么？”

大晚上的不休息，还有精力吵，真不知道说他们是闲得蛋疼，还是肾疼！

“你上面是不是还有位置，有的话让我们上去。”之前扔火球的那个女人立即出声，态度很是嚣张。

这里的人分成了三批，其中几个以这个女人为首，另外一批则是以和这个赵妍的女人对着干的几个人，剩下的则是事不关己的人，或则绝望哭泣的人，也有抱怨她们太吵，却不敢站出来说什么的。

那个赵妍也算是个重要女配，她是男主身边，那个得力助手，赵景大伯的女儿，他大伯临死前让赵景一定要找到赵妍，保护好她。

末世前赵景就一直被他大伯收养，那么多年的养育之恩，他自然要回报，在去B市的路上遇到了赵妍，他肯定要将她保护好。

可是这个赵妍呢，觊觎宋拾的美貌，对于能入宋拾眼的女主大人，自然是各种不顺眼，结局是被变成了丧尸，被赵景亲手杀了。

最后赵景也没落到个好。

赵妍单独在这里，怕是还没和赵景他们遇上。

In the middle of the night, there was a sudden noise downstairs, and someone was banging on the door. It was very noisy.Shi Sheng frowned and sat up. Qian Li was still huddled by the window. When he saw Shi Sheng moving, he immediately came over and looked at Shi Sheng's fingers eagerly.

Ma Gobi, want to eat again!

Shi Sheng resignedly fed the future Zombie King, pulled her hair irritably, and walked towards the door with the iron sword in hand.

Qian Li followed for two steps, but she didn't know what she thought of, and slowly retreated to the window.

Shi Sheng stood at the door and listened for a while. There was only noise but no screaming. Someone probably turned into a zombie. Then she opened the door.

The person outside the door smashed the object in vain. In the darkness, he saw a figure standing in front of him. The man screamed and took a few steps back.

Her cry attracted others, and someone used their powers to create a fireball and threw it in the direction of Shi Sheng.

That person probably just wanted to use it for lighting, so the fireball stopped one meter away from Shi Sheng, just enough for the people below to see her figure clearly.

"It was a person...it scared me to death. I thought it was a zombie."

"Just now, they said that there is someone on the third floor. If you insist on breaking down their door, it's okay now."

"We are not worried yet..."

"What are you worried about? Zhao Yan, don't think that no one knows about your little thoughts."

The crowd started making noise again. Shi Sheng rubbed his eyebrows with a headache and said angrily: "What do you want to do?"

They didn't rest at night and still had enough energy to make noises. I really don't know if they were so idle that their balls ached or their kidneys ached!

"Do you still have room above? If so, let us go up there." The woman who threw the fireball before immediately spoke up with a very arrogant attitude.

The people here were divided into three groups, several of which were led by this woman, the other group were those who were against this Zhao Yan woman, and the rest were people who had nothing to do with themselves, or people who were crying in despair. Some complained that they were too noisy, but did not dare to stand up and say anything.

That Zhao Yan is also an important female supporting character. She is the hero's right-hand man and the daughter of Uncle Zhao Jing. Before his death, his uncle asked Zhao Jing to find Zhao Yan and protect her.

Zhao Jing had been adopted by his uncle before the end of the world. He naturally wanted to repay the kindness of raising her for so many years. When he met Zhao Yan on the way to City B, he must protect her.

But this Zhao Yan coveted Song Shi's beauty. Naturally, she was displeased with the heroine who caught Song Shi's eyes. In the end, she was turned into a zombie and killed by Zhao Jing himself.

In the end, Zhao Jing didn't fare well either.

Zhao Yan is here alone, and she may not have met Zhao Jing and the others yet.
